scheme_name: International Centre for Environment Audit and Sustainable Development (iCED)
description:
The International Centre for Environment Audit and Sustainable Development (iCED) was established in 2010. 

It is located in Jaipur, Rajasthan. 

The primary objective of iCED is to promote sustainable development through effective environmental auditing. 

The centre aims to enhance the capacity of various stakeholders in the field of environmental management. 

iCED provides training and capacity-building programs to government officials, NGOs, and private sector representatives. 

The centre focuses on integrating environmental considerations into developmental planning and decision-making processes. 

iCED conducts research and development activities related to environmental audit and sustainable development practices. 

It aims to create a framework for conducting environmental audits in various sectors. 

The centre also works towards developing guidelines and standards for environmental auditing. 

iCED collaborates with national and international organizations to promote best practices in environmental management. 

The centre has been involved in various projects aimed at improving environmental governance in India. 

iCED seeks to raise awareness about the importance of environmental audits among stakeholders. 

The centre also aims to facilitate knowledge sharing and networking among professionals in the field. 

iCED has developed a comprehensive curriculum for training programs on environmental auditing. 

The training programs are designed to cater to the needs of different stakeholders. 

iCED conducts workshops, seminars, and conferences to disseminate knowledge on sustainable development. 

The centre has established partnerships with various academic institutions for research and training. 

iCED aims to strengthen the capacity of local bodies in conducting environmental audits. 

The centre also focuses on building a database of environmental audit reports for reference. 

iCED provides technical assistance to government departments in conducting environmental audits. 

The centre has been instrumental in developing tools and methodologies for effective environmental auditing. 

iCED promotes the use of technology in environmental monitoring and assessment. 

The centre has been involved in capacity building for the implementation of the National Green Tribunal Act. 

iCED aims to support the implementation of various environmental laws and regulations in India. 

The centre also works towards promoting corporate social responsibility in environmental management. 

iCED has conducted several studies to assess the environmental impact of various projects. 

The centre provides consultancy services to organizations seeking to improve their environmental performance. 

iCED has been recognized for its contributions to sustainable development by various national and international bodies. 

The centre aims to contribute to the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) set by the United Nations. 

iCED focuses on Goal 12 which is responsible consumption and production. 

The centre also addresses Goal 13 which is climate action through its initiatives. 

iCED has organized numerous training sessions for government officials on environmental auditing. 

The training sessions typically last for five days and cover various aspects of environmental management. 

Participants are provided with resource materials and toolkits for practical application. 

iCED has a dedicated team of experts in environmental science and policy. 

The centre regularly updates its training modules to incorporate the latest developments in environmental science. 

iCED has also developed an online platform for e-learning on environmental auditing. 

This platform allows participants to access training materials and resources remotely. 

iCED conducts assessments of environmental performance in various sectors such as manufacturing and agriculture. 

The centre has developed a framework for evaluating the environmental impact of industrial projects. 

iCED collaborates with the Ministry of Environment Forest and Climate Change for various initiatives. 

The centre also engages with state governments to promote sustainable practices at the local level. 

iCED has been involved in developing guidelines for environmental audits in the construction sector. 

The centre aims to ensure that construction projects comply with environmental regulations. 

iCED has also worked on projects related to waste management and pollution control. 

The centre has developed a model for assessing the environmental impact of urban development projects. 

iCED provides recommendations for improving environmental performance based on audit findings. 

The centre conducts follow-up assessments to evaluate the implementation of its recommendations. 

iCED has published several research papers and reports on environmental auditing and sustainable development. 

These publications serve as a resource for policymakers and practitioners in the field. 

iCED also participates in international conferences to share its experiences and learn from global best practices. 

The centre has been involved in capacity-building initiatives in neighboring countries as well. 

iCED aims to foster regional cooperation in environmental management. 

The centre conducts outreach programs to engage communities in sustainable practices. 

iCED encourages public participation in environmental decision-making processes. 

The centre has developed a network of professionals working in the field of environmental auditing. 

This network facilitates knowledge exchange and collaboration among members. 

iCED aims to create a culture of accountability and transparency in environmental governance. 

The centre has been instrumental in promoting the concept of green audits among businesses. 

iCED provides guidance to companies on how to conduct their own environmental audits. 

The centre also recognizes organizations that demonstrate excellence in environmental management. 

iCED has established an awards program to honor outstanding contributions to sustainable development. 

The centre aims to inspire others to adopt environmentally responsible practices. 

iCED continues to evolve its programs and initiatives to address emerging environmental challenges. 

The centre remains committed to its mission of promoting sustainable development through effective environmental auditing. 

iCED plays a crucial role in shaping environmental policies and practices in India. 

The centre is dedicated to building a sustainable future for generations to come. 

iCED is a vital resource for anyone interested in environmental auditing and sustainable development. 

The centre's work is essential for achieving a balance between economic growth and environmental protection. 

iCED's initiatives contribute significantly to the overall improvement of environmental quality in India. 

The centre's focus on capacity building ensures that stakeholders are equipped to tackle environmental issues effectively. 

iCED is a beacon of hope for sustainable development in India and beyond.
